consequences: No budget increase or policy weakening. Old records remain incomplete; this does not bridge independent workers or prove installed-app readiness.
context: Real follow-up exceeded the 2200 control-token pool because identical interpretation was serialized twice; prompt projection also removed subsystem health and arbitration details before diagnostics reconstructed them.
decision: At generation projection remove only an exactly identical nested interpretation, retaining the full top-level controls and fail-closed budget. Capture allowlisted pre-generation decisions in encrypted turn execution evidence, separately from the model prompt, including live and failed turns.
title: Deduplicate generation context while preserving independent L0 decision evidence
